title: Present simple + in / on / at
title_it: Present simple e in / on / at
goal: Talk about routines and facts, and use at, on and in with time.
goal_it: Parlare di routine e fatti e usare at, on e in con il tempo.

title: Present continuous
goal: Talk about what is happening now and use the -ing form correctly.
goal_it: Parlare di ciò che sta accadendo adesso e usare correttamente la forma -ing.

title: Listening: A phone call at the station
goal: Understand a short phone call, and practise telling the time and the present continuous.
goal_it: Capire una breve telefonata ed esercitare l'ora e il present continuous.

title: Present simple vs continuous + adverbs of frequency
title_it: Present simple vs continuous + avverbi di frequenza
goal: Choose between present simple and continuous and place adverbs of frequency correctly.
goal_it: Scegliere tra present simple e continuous e collocare correttamente gli avverbi di frequenza.

title: Writing: A typical day
goal: Write about your daily routine with the present simple, frequency adverbs and the present continuous.
goal_it: Scrivere della tua routine con present simple, avverbi di frequenza e present continuous.

title: Reading: At the airport
goal: Check in, pass security and find your gate.
goal_it: Fare il check-in e trovare il gate.

title: Reading: Asking for directions
goal: Ask the way and understand the answer.
goal_it: Chiedere la strada e capire la risposta.

title: Reading: At a restaurant
goal: Book a table, order food and ask for the bill.
goal_it: Prenotare, ordinare e chiedere il conto.
